hero.badge: Next-Gen Enterprise Healthcare Management Platform v22
hero.subtitle: High-performance platform built on Angular v22 Signals & Zoneless Architecture featuring full Offline-First operation and HIPAA-compliant data security.

capabilities.title: Cutting-edge Architecture Designed for Future Medicine
capabilities.subtitle: Built using modern web standards to ensure maximum responsiveness and 24/7 operational reliability.
capabilities.cap1Desc: Completely eliminates Zone.js overhead by directly relying on Angular Signals for instantaneous UI updates with 0ms extra change detection latency.
capabilities.cap2Desc: Instantaneous data synchronization powered by IndexedDB & Service Worker to keep clinics operating seamlessly even during network outages.
capabilities.cap3Desc: Role-Based Access Control enforcing strict patient privacy and full compliance with international HIPAA health data security standards.
capabilities.cap4Desc: Instantaneous sync between clinics, pharmacy, lab, and radiology to dispatch prescriptions and diagnostic results with zero delay.

modules.title: 10 Core Modules Covering Every Healthcare Operation
modules.subtitle: Explore intelligent digital solutions designed for doctors, patients, and executive hospital management.
modules.m1Desc: Live command center delivering critical Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), bed occupancy rates, daily revenue, and patient flow dynamics.
modules.m2Desc: Comprehensive doctor calendar management, outpatient booking, automated rescheduling, and WhatsApp/SMS appointment reminders.
modules.m3Desc: Automated waiting hall patient calling system connected to digital display boards and voice announcements, reducing wait times by 45%.
modules.m4Desc: Encrypted digital patient archive containing medical history, allergies, surgical records, vital sign trends, and clinical notes.
modules.m4Feat1: Rapid timeline view of past visits
modules.m5Desc: Receive digital prescriptions instantly from clinics, dispense medications via barcode scanning, and track inventory expiration alerts.
modules.m6Desc: Specimen sample management, automated lab analyzer device integration for result ingestion, and instant report generation.
modules.m7Desc: Radiology workflow management supporting X-Ray, MRI, and CT scan devices with high-performance in-browser DICOM image rendering.
modules.m8Desc: Dedicated streamlined workspace enabling physicians to view queue lists, document diagnoses, issue prescriptions, and order lab tests with one click.
modules.m9Desc: Manage medical staff files, duty shift rosters, attendance, and role-based access permissions tailored per department.
modules.m10Desc: WebSocket-powered instant alert system notifying medical teams during emergencies, reminding patients of appointments, and providing live support.
modules.m10Feat1: Instant ER emergency team dispatch alerts
